description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for six different models, namely Base, FT, IKE, MEND, MEMIT, and ROME. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The six lines in the plot represent the different models, with Base in black, FT in blue, IKE in red, MEND in brown, MEMIT in purple, and ROME in green; all lines are solid and marked with distinct shapes. The Base line starts at around 62 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to approximately 70 at 3*10^3. The FT line begins at around 64 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rises to about 72 at 3*10^3. The IKE line commences at roughly 66 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and ascends to approximately 75 at 3*10^3. The MEND line starts at around 70 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and increases to about 82 at 3*10^3. The MEMIT line begins at approximately 72 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and rises to around 78 at 3*10^3. The ROME line starts at roughly 75 at a Co-occurrence Number of 3 and ascends to approximately 87 at 3*10^3. All lines exhibit a steady upward trend across the x-axis.
